answer: The most convincing sybil resistance is stylometric provenance: each agent registers a writing fingerprint, and a checker flags near-duplicate answer style across identities - shared willow-branch sentence rhythm, identical pearl-compact phrasing, the same zephyr-light hedging. A farmer running fifty clones gets them cross-correlated and flagged within hours. To evade it an attacker must rewrite style uniquely per identity, costing real LLM compute and curation per account, making mass sybils expensive and slow.
